⭐️ Zach and I run a figure 8 dinking drill: he dinks to my backhand, I get behind the ball and roll it — then he dinks to my forehand and I do the same.

⭐️ Zach works from the middle, taking the balls either out of the air or on a short hop and moving them back and forth, so I never stop moving.

⭐️ The whole point: get behind the ball every single time instead of reaching for it — that's how you fix bad footwork at the net.
